ayahs.textUthmani: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ لِيَكُونَ لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ نَذِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ لِيَكُونَ لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ نَذِيرًا ۝١
ayahs.textIndopak: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِيْ نَزَّلَ الْفُرْقَانَ عَلٰي عَبْدِهٖ لِيَكُوْنَ لِلْعٰلَمِيْنَ نَذِيْرَا ۙ
ayahs.translation: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His Servant that he may be to the worlds a warner -
ayahs.transliteration: Tabaarakal-ladhee nazzalal-furqaana 'alaa 'abdihee liyakoona lil'aalameena nadheeraa
ayahs.translationClear: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His servant, to be a warning to humanity.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكٌ فِى ٱلْمُلْكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ تَقْدِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكٌ فِى ٱلْمُلْكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ تَقْدِيرًا ۝٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اࣙلَّذِيْ لَهٗ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَّلَمْ يَكُنْ لَّهٗ شَرِيْكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ فَقَدَّرَهٗ تَقْدِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and who has not taken a son and has not had a partner in dominion and has created each thing and determined it with [precise] determination.
ayahs.transliteration: Al-ladhee lahoo mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi walam yattakhidh waladan walam yakul lahoo shareekun fil-mulki wakhalaqa kulla shay'in faqaddarahoo taqdeeraa
ayahs.translationClear: He to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, who took to Himself no son, who never had a partner in His kingship; who created everything and determined its measure.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً لَّا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ مَوْتًا وَلَا حَيَوٰةً وَلَا نُشُورًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً لَّا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ مَوْتًا وَلَا حَيَوٰةً وَلَا نُشُورًا ۝٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖٓ اٰلِهَةً لَّا يَخْلُقُوْنَ شَيْـٔ͏ًا وَّهُمْ يُخْلَقُوْنَ وَلَا يَمْلِكُوْنَ لِاَنْفُسِهِمْ ضَرًّا وَّلَا نَفْعًا وَّلَا يَمْلِكُوْنَ مَوْتًا وَّلَا حَيٰوةً وَّلَا نُشُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: But they have taken besides Him gods which create nothing, while they are created, and possess not for themselves any harm or benefit and possess not [power to cause] death or life or resurrection.
ayahs.transliteration: Wattakhadhoo min doonihee aalihatal laa yakhluqoona shay'an wahum yukhlaqoona walaa yamlikoona li'anfusihim darran walaa naf'an walaa yamlikoona mawtan walaa hayaatan walaa nushooraa
ayahs.translationClear: And yet, instead of Him, they produce for themselves gods that create nothing, but are themselves created; that have no power to harm or benefit themselves; and no power over life, death, or resurrection.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ وَأَعَانَهُۥ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمٌ ءَاخَرُونَ ۖ فَقَدْ جَآءُو ظُلْمًا وَزُورًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ وَأَعَانَهُۥ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمٌ ءَاخَرُونَ‌ۖ فَقَدْ جَآءُو ظُلْمًا وَزُورًا ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْٓا اِنْ هٰذَا͏ٓ اِلَّا͏ٓ اِفْكُ اࣙفْتَرٰىهُ وَاَعَانَهٗ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمٌ اٰخَرُوْنَۚۛ فَقَدْ جَا࢜ءُوْ ظُلْمًا وَّزُوْرًا ۚۛ
ayahs.translation: And those who disbelieve say, "This [Qur’ān] is not except a falsehood he invented, and another people assisted him in it." But they have committed an injustice and a lie.
ayahs.transliteration: Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo in haadhaa illaa ifkuniftaraahu wa'a'aanahoo 'alayhi qawmun aakharoona faqad jaa'oo zulman wazooraa
ayahs.translationClear: Those who disbelieve say, “This is nothing but a lie that he made up, and others have helped him at it.” They have committed an injustice and a perjury.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ٱكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِىَ تُمْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ٱكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِىَ تُمْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا ۝٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالُوْٓا اَسَاطِيْرُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ اكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِيَ تُمْلٰي عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةً وَّاَصِيْلًا
ayahs.translation: And they say, "Legends of the former peoples which he has written down, and they are dictated to him morning and afternoon."
ayahs.transliteration: Waqaaloo asaateerul-awwaleenaktatabahaa fahiya tumlaa 'alayhi bukratan wa'aseelaa
ayahs.translationClear: And they say, “Tales of the ancients; he wrote them down; they are dictated to him morning and evening.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ أَنزَلَهُ ٱلَّذِى يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ أَنزَلَهُ ٱلَّذِى يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اَنْزَلَهُ الَّذِيْ يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِيْمًا
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed by He who knows [every] secret within the heavens and the earth. Indeed, He is ever Forgiving and Merciful."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul anzalahul-ladhee ya'lamus-sirra fis-samaawaati wal-ardi innahoo kaana ghafoorar raheemaa
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “It was revealed by Him who knows the secret in the heavens and the earth. He is always Forgiving and Merciful.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ مَالِ هَـٰذَا ٱلرَّسُولِ يَأْكُلُ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشِى فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ ۙ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُۥ نَذِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالُوا۟ مَالِ هَـٰذَا ٱلرَّسُولِ يَأْكُلُ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشِى فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ‌ۙ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُۥ نَذِيرًا ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالُوْا مَالِ هٰذَا الرَّسُوْلِ يَاْكُلُ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشِيْ فِي الْاَسْوَاقِؕ لَوْلَا͏ٓ اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ فَيَكُوْنَ مَعَهٗ نَذِيْرًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: And they say, "What is this messenger that eats food and walks in the markets? Why was there not sent down to him an angel so he would be with him a warner?
ayahs.transliteration: Waqaaloo maali haadhar-rasooli ya'kulut-ta'aama wayamshee fil-aswaaqi lawlaa unzila ilayhi malakun fayakoona ma'ahoo nadheeraa
ayahs.translationClear: And they say, “What sort of messenger is this, who eats food, and walks in the marketplaces? If only an angel was sent down with him, to be alongside him a warner.”

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوْ يُلْقَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ تَكُونُ لَهُۥ جَنَّةٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا ۚ وَقَالَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُورًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوْ يُلْقَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ تَكُونُ لَهُۥ جَنَّةٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا‌ۚ وَقَالَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُورًا ۝٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوْ يُلْقٰٓي اِلَيْهِ كَنْزٌ اَوْ تَكُوْنُ لَهٗ جَنَّةٌ يَّاْكُلُ مِنْهَاؕ وَقَالَ الظّٰلِمُوْنَ اِنْ تَتَّبِعُوْنَ اِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: Or [why is not] a treasure presented to him [from heaven], or does he [not] have a garden from which he eats?" And the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."
ayahs.transliteration: Aw yulqaa ilayhi kanzun aw takoonu lahoo jannatun ya'kulu minhaa waqaalaz-zaalimoona in tattabi'oona illaa rajulam mas'hooraa
ayahs.translationClear: Or, “If only a treasure was dropped on him.” Or, “If only he had a garden from which he eats.” The evildoers also say, “You are following but a man under spell.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا۟ لَكَ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ فَضَلُّوا۟ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا۟ لَكَ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ فَضَلُّوا۟ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا ۝٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اُنْظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوْا لَكَ الْاَمْثَالَ فَضَلُّوْا فَلَا يَسْتَطِيْعُوْنَ سَبِيْلًا ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Look how they strike for you comparisons;[1009] but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.
ayahs.transliteration: Unzur kayfa daraboo lakal-amthaala fadalloo falaa yastatee'oona sabeelaa

footnotes.1009: From their own imaginations in order to deny and discredit you.

ayahs.translationClear: Look how they invent examples for you. They have gone astray, and cannot find a way.

ayahs.textUthmani: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِن شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًا مِّن ذَٰلِكَ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ وَيَجْعَل لَّكَ قُصُورًۢا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِن شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًا مِّن ذَٰلِكَ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ وَيَجْعَل لَّكَ قُصُورًۢا ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِيْٓ اِنْ شَا࢜ءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًا مِّنْ ذٰلِكَ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُۙ وَيَجْعَلْ لَّكَ قُصُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: Blessed is He who, if He willed, could have made for you [something] better than that - gardens beneath which rivers flow - and could make for you palaces.
ayahs.transliteration: Tabaarakal-ladhee in shaa'a ja'ala laka khayram min dhaalika jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru wayaj'al laka qusooraa
ayahs.translationClear: Blessed is He who, if He wills, can provide you with better than that—gardens beneath which rivers flow—and He will give you palaces.

ayahs.textUthmani: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ‌ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: بَلْ كَذَّبُوْا بِالسَّاعَةِࣞ وَاَعْتَدْنَا لِمَنْ كَذَّبَ بِالسَّاعَةِ سَعِيْرًا ۚ
ayahs.translation: But they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze.
ayahs.transliteration: Bal kadhdhaboo bis-saa'ati wa'a'tadnaa liman kadhdhaba bis-saa'ati sa'eeraa
ayahs.translationClear: In fact, they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِذَا رَأَتْهُم مِّن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَزَفِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذَا رَأَتْهُم مِّن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَزَفِيرًا ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اِذَا رَاَتْهُمْ مِّنْ مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيْدٍ سَمِعُوْا لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَّزَفِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: When it [i.e., the Hellfire] sees them from a distant place, they will hear its fury and roaring.
ayahs.transliteration: Idhaa ra'at'hum mim makaanim ba'eedin sami'oo lahaa taghayyuzan wazafeeraa
ayahs.translationClear: When it sees them from a distant place, they will hear it raging and roaring.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ مِنْهَا مَكَانًا ضَيِّقًا مُّقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوْا۟ هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ مِنْهَا مَكَانًا ضَيِّقًا مُّقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوْا۟ هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورًا ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِذَا͏ٓ اُلْقُوْا مِنْهَا مَكَانًا ضَيِّقًا مُّقَرَّنِيْنَ دَعَوْا هُنَالِكَ ثُبُوْرًا ؕ
ayahs.translation: And when they are thrown into a narrow place therein bound in chains, they will cry out thereupon for destruction.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'idhaa ulqoo minhaa makaanan dayyiqam muqarraneena da'aw hunaalika thubooraa
ayahs.translationClear: And when they are thrown into it, into a tight place, shackled, they will plead there for death.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَّا تَدْعُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ثُبُورًا وَٰحِدًا وَٱدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا كَثِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَّا تَدْعُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ثُبُورًا وَٰحِدًا وَٱدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا كَثِيرًا ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: لَا تَدْعُوا الْيَوْمَ ثُبُوْرًا وَّاحِدًا وَّادْعُوْا ثُبُوْرًا كَثِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: [They will be told], "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction."
ayahs.transliteration: Laa tad'ul-yawma thubooran waahidan wad'oo thubooran katheeraa
ayahs.translationClear: “Do not plead for one death today, but plead for a great many deaths.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ ٱلْخُلْدِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ۚ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَآءً وَمَصِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ ٱلْخُلْدِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ‌ۚ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَآءً وَمَصِيرًا ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اَذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ اَمْ جَنَّةُ الْخُلْدِ الَّتِيْ وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُوْنَؕ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَا࢜ءً وَّمَصِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: Say, "Is that better or the Garden of Eternity which is promised to the righteous? It will be for them a reward and destination.
ayahs.transliteration: Qul adhaalika khayrun am jannatul-khuldil-latee wu'idal-muttaqoona kaanat lahum jazaa'an wamaseeraa
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “Is this better, or the Garden of Eternity promised to the righteous? It is for them a reward and a destination.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَّهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ خَـٰلِدِينَ ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَعْدًا مَّسْـُٔولًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَّهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ خَـٰلِدِينَ‌ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَعْدًا مَّسْـُٔولًا ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: لَهُمْ فِيْهَا مَا يَشَا࢜ءُوْنَ خٰلِدِيْنَؕ كَانَ عَلٰي رَبِّكَ وَعْدًا مَّسْـٔ͏ُوْلًا
ayahs.translation: For them therein is whatever they wish, [while] abiding eternally. It is ever upon your Lord a promise [worthy to be] requested.[1010]
ayahs.transliteration: Lahum feehaa maa yashaa'oona khaalideena kaana 'alaa rabbika wa'dam mas'oolaa

footnotes.1010: Or "...a promise requested [for them by the angels]."

ayahs.translationClear: They will have therein whatever they desire, forever. That is upon your Lord a binding promise.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَأَنتُمْ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِى هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ أَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوا۟ ٱلسَّبِيلَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَأَنتُمْ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِى هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ أَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوا۟ ٱلسَّبِيلَ ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ فَيَقُوْلُ ءَاَنْتُمْ اَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِيْ هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ اَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوا السَّبِيْلَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And [mention] the Day He will gather them and that which they worship besides Allāh and will say, "Did you mislead these, My servants, or did they [themselves] stray from the way?"
ayahs.transliteration: Wayawma yahshuruhum wamaa ya'budoona min doonillaahi fayaqoolu a'antum adlaltum 'ibaadee haa'ulaa'i am hum dallus-sabeel
ayahs.translationClear: On the Day when He gathers them, and what they worshiped besides Allah, He will say, “Was it you who misled these servants of Mine, or was it they who lost the way?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنۢبَغِى لَنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ مِن دُونِكَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ وَلَـٰكِن مَّتَّعْتَهُمْ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَسُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بُورًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنۢبَغِى لَنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ مِن دُونِكَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ وَلَـٰكِن مَّتَّعْتَهُمْ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَسُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بُورًا ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا سُبْحٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنۢ͏ْبَغِيْ لَنَا͏ٓ اَنْ نَّتَّخِذَ مِنْ دُوْنِكَ مِنْ اَوْلِيَا࢜ءَ وَلٰكِنْ مَّتَّعْتَهُمْ وَاٰبَا࢜ءَهُمْ حَتّٰي نَسُوا الذِّكْرَۚ وَكَانُوْا قَوْمًاۢ بُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: They will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for us to take besides You any allies [i.e., protectors]. But You provided comforts for them and their fathers until they forgot the message and became a people ruined."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo subhaanaka maa kaana yambaghee lanaa an nattakhidha min doonika min awliyaa'a walaakim matta'tahum wa'aabaa'ahum hattaa nasudh-dhikra wakaanoo qawmam booraa
ayahs.translationClear: They will say, “Glory be to You. It was not for us to take any lords besides You. But You gave them enjoyments, and their ancestors, until they forgot the Message, and became ruined people.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُم بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًا وَلَا نَصْرًا ۚ وَمَن يَظْلِم مِّنكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًا كَبِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُم بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًا وَلَا نَصْرًا‌ۚ وَمَن يَظْلِم مِّنكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًا كَبِيرًا ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوْكُمْ بِمَا تَقُوْلُوْنَۙ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيْعُوْنَ صَرْفًا وَّلَا نَصْرًاۚ وَمَنْ يَّظْلِمْ مِّنْكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًا كَبِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: So they will deny you, [disbelievers], in what you say,[1011] and you cannot avert [punishment] or [find] help. And whoever commits injustice[1012] among you - We will make him taste a great punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: Faqad kadhdhabookum bimaa taqooloona famaa tastatee'oona sarfan walaa nasran waman yazlim minkum nudhiqhu 'adhaaban kabeeraa

footnotes.1011: At the time of Judgement the false objects of worship will betray their worshippers and deny them.
footnotes.1012: Specifically, association of others with Allāh.

ayahs.translationClear: They have denied you because of what you say; so you can neither avert, nor help. Whoever among you commits injustice, We will make him taste a grievous punishment.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ ۗ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةً أَتَصْبِرُونَ ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ‌ۗ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةً أَتَصْبِرُونَ‌ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًا ۝٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ اِلَّا͏ٓ اِنَّهُمْ لَيَاْكُلُوْنَ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُوْنَ فِي الْاَسْوَاقِؕ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةًؕ اَتَصْبِرُوْنَۚ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيْرًا ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And We did not send before you, [O Muḥammad], any of the messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you [people] as trial for others - will you have patience? And ever is your Lord, Seeing.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa arsalnaa qablaka minal-mursaleena illaa innahum laya'kuloonat-ta'aama wayamshoona fil-aswaaqi waja'alnaa ba'dakum liba'din fitnatan atasbiroona wakaana rabbuka baseeraa
ayahs.translationClear: We never sent any messengers before you, but they ate food and walked in the marketplaces. And We made some of you tempters for one another—will you be patient? Your Lord is always Observing.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَا ۗ لَقَدِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْ عُتُوًّا كَبِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَا‌ۗ لَقَدِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْ عُتُوًّا كَبِيرًا ۝٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يَرْجُوْنَ لِقَا࢜ءَنَا لَوْلَا͏ٓ اُنْزِلَ عَلَيْنَا الْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةُ اَوْ نَرٰي رَبَّنَاؕ لَقَدِ اسْتَكْبَرُوْا فِيْٓ اَنْفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْ عُتُوًّا كَبِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Why were not angels sent down to us, or [why] do we [not] see our Lord?" They have certainly become arrogant within themselves[1013] and [become] insolent with great insolence.
ayahs.transliteration: Waqaalal-ladheena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa lawlaa unzila 'alaynal-malaa'ikatu aw naraa rabbanaa laqadistakbaroo fee anfusihim wa'ataw 'utuwwan kabeeraa

footnotes.1013: Additional meanings are "among themselves" and "over [the matter of] themselves."

ayahs.translationClear: Those who do not expect to meet Us say, “If only the angels were sent down to us, or we could see our Lord.” They have grown arrogant within themselves, and have become excessively defiant.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا ۝٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ الْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةَ لَا بُشْرٰي يَوْمَىِٕذٍ لِّلْمُجْرِمِيْنَ وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: The day they see the angels[1014] - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."[1015]
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma yarawnal-malaa'ikata laa bushraa yawma'idhil lilmujrimeena wayaqooloona hijram mahjooraa

footnotes.1014: i.e., at the time of death.

ayahs.translationClear: On the Day when they see the angels—there will be no good news for sinners on that Day; and they will say, “A protective refuge.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَدِمْنَآ إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ هَبَآءً مَّنثُورًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَدِمْنَآ إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ هَبَآءً مَّنثُورًا ۝٢٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَدِمْنَا͏ٓ اِلٰي مَا عَمِلُوْا مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنٰهُ هَبَا࢜ءً مَّنْثُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: And We will approach [i.e., regard][1016] what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.
ayahs.transliteration: Waqadimnaa ilaa maa 'amiloo min 'amalin faja'alnaahu habaa'am manthooraa
ayahs.translationClear: We will proceed to the works they did, and will turn them into scattered dust.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌ مُّسْتَقَرًّا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌ مُّسْتَقَرًّا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًا ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اَصْحٰبُ الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَىِٕذٍ خَيْرٌ مُّسْتَقَرًّا وَّاَحْسَنُ مَقِيْلًا
ayahs.translation: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are [in] a better settlement and better resting place.
ayahs.transliteration: As'haabul-jannati yawma'idhin khayrum mustaqarran wa'ahsanu maqeelaa
ayahs.translationClear: The companions of Paradise on that Day will be better lodged, and more fairly accommodated.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِٱلْغَمَـٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِٱلْغَمَـٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا ۝٢٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ السَّمَا࢜ءُ بِالْغَمَامِ وَنُزِّلَ الْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةُ تَنْزِيْلًا
ayahs.translation: And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds,[1017] and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.
ayahs.transliteration: Wayawma tashaqqaqus-samaa'u bil-ghamaami wanuzzilal-malaa'ikatu tanzeelaa
ayahs.translationClear: The Day when the sky is cleft with clouds, and the angels are sent down in streams.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَسِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ‌ۚ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَسِيرًا ۝٢٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَىِٕذِ اࣙلْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمٰنِؕ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَي الْكٰفِرِيْنَ عَسِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day.
ayahs.transliteration: Al-mulku yawma'idhinil-haqqu lirrahmaani wakaana yawman 'alal-kaafireena 'aseeraa
ayahs.translationClear: On that Day, true sovereignty will belong to the Merciful, and it will be a difficult Day for the disbelievers.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ ٱلظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى ٱتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ ٱلرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ ٱلظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى ٱتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ ٱلرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًا ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ الظَّالِمُ عَلٰي يَدَيْهِ يَقُوْلُ يٰلَيْتَنِي اتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ الرَّسُوْلِ سَبِيْلًا
ayahs.translation: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [in regret] he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.[1018]
ayahs.transliteration: Wayawma ya'adduz-zaalimu 'alaa yadayhi yaqoolu yaalaytanittakhadhtu ma'ar-rasooli sabeelaa

footnotes.1018: i.e., followed the Prophet (ﷺ) on a path of guidance.

ayahs.translationClear: On that Day, the wrongdoer will bite his hands, and say, “If only I had followed the way with the Messenger.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَـٰوَيْلَتَىٰ لَيْتَنِى لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَـٰوَيْلَتَىٰ لَيْتَنِى لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًا ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: يٰوَيْلَتٰي لَيْتَنِيْ لَمْ اَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيْلًا
ayahs.translation: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one[1019] as a friend.
ayahs.transliteration: Yaawaylataa laytanee lam attakhidh fulaanan khaleelaa
ayahs.translationClear: Oh, woe to me; I wish I never took so-and-so for a friend.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَّقَدْ أَضَلَّنِى عَنِ ٱلذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَنِى ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ خَذُولًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَّقَدْ أَضَلَّنِى عَنِ ٱلذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَنِى‌ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ خَذُولًا ۝٢٩
ayahs.textIndopak: لَقَدْ اَضَلَّنِيْ عَنِ الذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ اِذْ جَا࢜ءَنِيْؕ وَكَانَ الشَّيْطٰنُ لِلْاِنْسَانِ خَذُوْلًا
ayahs.translation: He led me away from the remembrance[1020] after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."[1021]
ayahs.transliteration: Laqad adallanee 'anidh-dhikri ba'da idh jaa'anee wakaanash-shaytaanu lil'insaani khadhoolaa

footnotes.1020: i.e., the Qur’ān or the remembrance of Allāh.
footnotes.1021: Forsaking him once he has led him into evil.

ayahs.translationClear: He led me away from the Message after it had come to me; for Satan has always been a betrayer of man.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يَـٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مَهْجُورًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يَـٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مَهْجُورًا ۝٣٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالَ الرَّسُوْلُ يٰرَبِّ اِنَّ قَوْمِي اتَّخَذُوْا هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنَ مَهْجُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur’ān as [a thing] abandoned."[1022]
ayahs.transliteration: Waqaalar-rasoolu yaarabbi inna qawmittakhadhoo haadhal-qur'aana mahjooraa

footnotes.1022: i.e., avoiding it, not listening to or understanding it, not living by it, or preferring something else to it.

ayahs.translationClear: And the Messenger will say, “My Lord, my people have abandoned this Quran.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّا مِّنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَنَصِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّا مِّنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ‌ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَنَصِيرًا ۝٣١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَكَذٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوًّا مِّنَ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَؕ وَكَفٰي بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَّنَصِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper.
ayahs.transliteration: Wakadhaalika ja'alnaa likulli nabiyyin 'aduwwam minal-mujrimeena wakafaa birabbika haadiyan wanaseeraa
ayahs.translationClear: Likewise, to every prophet We assign enemies from among the wicked. But your Lord suffices as a Guide and Savior.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ جُمْلَةً وَٰحِدَةً ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَـٰهُ تَرْتِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ جُمْلَةً وَٰحِدَةً‌ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ‌ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَـٰهُ تَرْتِيلًا ۝٣٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الْقُرْاٰنُ جُمْلَةً وَّاحِدَةًۚۛ كَذٰلِكَۚۛ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهٖ فُو͏ٔ͏َادَكَ وَرَتَّلْنٰهُ تَرْتِيْلًا
ayahs.translation: And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur’ān not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.[1023]
ayahs.transliteration: Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo lawlaa nuzzila 'alayhil-qur'aanu jumlatan waahidatan kadhaalika linuthabbita bihee fu'aadaka warattalnaahu tarteelaa
ayahs.translationClear: Those who disbelieve say, “Why was the Quran not revealed to him at once?” Thus in order to strengthen your heart thereby, and We revealed it in stages.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا ۝٣٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَا يَاْتُوْنَكَ بِمَثَلٍ اِلَّا جِي͏ٔ͏ْنٰكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَاَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيْرًا ؕ
ayahs.translation: And they do not come to you with an example [i.e., argument] except that We bring you the truth and the best explanation.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaa ya'toonaka bimathalin illaa ji'naaka bil-haqqi wa'ahsana tafseeraa
ayahs.translationClear: Whatever argument they come to you with, We provide you with the truth, and a better exposition.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا ۝٣٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلَّذِيْنَ يُحْشَرُوْنَ عَلٰي وُجُوْهِهِمْ اِلٰي جَهَنَّمَۙ اُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَّاَضَلُّ سَبِيْلًا ࣖ
ayahs.translation: The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way.
ayahs.transliteration: Al-ladheena yuhsharoona 'alaa wujoohihim ilaa jahannama ulaa'ika sharrum makaanan wa'adallu sabeelaa
ayahs.translationClear: Those who are herded into Hell on their faces—those are in a worse position, and further astray from the way.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ وَزِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ وَزِيرًا ۝٣٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنَا مُوْسَي الْكِتٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهٗٓ اَخَاهُ هٰرُوْنَ وَزِيْرًا ۚۖ
ayahs.translation: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad aataynaa moosal-kitaaba waja'alnaa ma'ahoo akhaahu haaroona wazeeraa
ayahs.translationClear: We gave Moses the Scripture, and appointed his brother Aaron as his assistant.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَقُلْنَا ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَدَمَّرْنَـٰهُمْ تَدْمِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَقُلْنَا ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَدَمَّرْنَـٰهُمْ تَدْمِيرًا ۝٣٦
ayahs.textIndopak: فَقُلْنَا اذْهَبَا͏ٓ اِلَي الْقَوْمِ الَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَاؕ فَدَمَّرْنٰهُمْ تَدْمِيْرًا ؕ
ayahs.translation: And We said, "Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs." Then We destroyed them with [complete] destruction.
ayahs.transliteration: Faqulnadhhabaa ilal-qawmil-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa fadammarnaahum tadmeeraa
ayahs.translationClear: We said, “Go to the people who rejected Our signs,” and We destroyed them completely.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا۟ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةً ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا۟ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةً‌ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا ۝٣٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَوْمَ نُوْحٍ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا الرُّسُلَ اَغْرَقْنٰهُمْ وَجَعَلْنٰهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ اٰيَةًؕ وَاَعْتَدْنَا لِلظّٰلِمِيْنَ عَذَابًا اَلِيْمًا ۚۖ
ayahs.translation: And the people of Noah - when they denied the messengers,[1024] We drowned them, and We made them for mankind a sign. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: Waqawma noohil lammaa kadhdhabur-rusula aghraqnaahum waja'alnaahum linnaasi aayatan wa'a'tadnaa lizzaalimeena 'adhaaban aleemaa

footnotes.1024: Their denial of Noah was as if they had denied all those who brought the same message from Allāh.

ayahs.translationClear: And the people of Noah: when they rejected the messengers, We drowned them, and made them a lesson for mankind. We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful retribution.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَأَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًۢا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَأَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًۢا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرًا ۝٣٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّعَادًا وَّثَمُوْدَا۟ وَاَصْحٰبَ الرَّسِّ وَقُرُوْنًاۢ بَيْنَ ذٰلِكَ كَثِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: And [We destroyed] ʿAad and Thamūd and the companions of the well[1025] and many generations between them.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'aadan wathamooda wa'as'haabar-rassi waquroonam bayna dhaalika katheeraa

footnotes.1025: Said to be a people who denied Prophet Shuʿayb or possibly those mentioned in Sūrah Yā Seen, 36:13-29.

ayahs.translationClear: And Aad, and Thamood, and the inhabitants of Arras, and many generations in between.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَكُلًّا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ ۖ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكُلًّا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ‌ۖ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًا ۝٣٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَكُلًّا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ الْاَمْثَالَؗ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction.
ayahs.transliteration: Wakullan darabnaa lahul-amthaala wakullan tabbarnaa tatbeeraa
ayahs.translationClear: To each We presented the parables; and each We devastated utterly.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَى ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۚ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَرَوْنَهَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَى ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ ٱلسَّوْءِ‌ۚ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَرَوْنَهَا‌ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًا ۝٤٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ اَتَوْا عَلَي الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِيْٓ اُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ السَّوْءِؕ اَفَلَمْ يَكُوْنُوْا يَرَوْنَهَاۚ بَلْ كَانُوْا لَا يَرْجُوْنَ نُشُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: And they have already come upon the town which was showered with a rain of evil [i.e., stones]. So have they not seen it? But they are not expecting resurrection.[1026]
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad ataw 'alal-qaryatil-latee umtirat mataras-saw'i afalam yakoonoo yarawnahaa bal kaanoo laa yarjoona nushooraa

footnotes.1026: So they do not benefit from lessons of the past.

ayahs.translationClear: And they came upon the city that was drenched by the terrible rain. Did they not see it? But they do not expect resurrection.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى بَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى بَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولًا ۝٤١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِذَا رَاَوْكَ اِنْ يَّتَّخِذُوْنَكَ اِلَّا هُزُوًاؕ اَهٰذَا الَّذِيْ بَعَثَ اللّٰهُ رَسُوْلًا
ayahs.translation: And when they see you, [O Muḥammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one whom Allāh has sent as a messenger?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'idhaa ra'awka in yattakhidhoonaka illaa huzuwan ahaadhal-ladhee ba'athallaahu rasoolaa
ayahs.translationClear: And when they see you, they take you for nothing but mockery: “Is this the one Allah sent as a messenger?”

ayahs.textUthmani: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوْلَآ أَن صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوْلَآ أَن صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا‌ۚ وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا ۝٤٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنْ كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ اٰلِهَتِنَا لَوْلَا͏ٓ اَنْ صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَاؕ وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُوْنَ حِيْنَ يَرَوْنَ الْعَذَابَ مَنْ اَضَلُّ سَبِيْلًا
ayahs.translation: He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way.
ayahs.transliteration: In kaada layudillunaa 'an aalihatinaa lawlaa an sabarnaa 'alayhaa wasawfa ya'lamoona heena yarawnal-'adhaaba man adallu sabeelaa
ayahs.translationClear: “He nearly led us away from our gods, had we not patiently adhered to them.” But they will know, when they witness the torment, who is further away from the way.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَـٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَـٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا ۝٤٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰهَهٗ هَوٰىهُؕ اَفَاَنْتَ تَكُوْنُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيْلًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him?
ayahs.transliteration: Ara'ayta manittakhadha ilaahahoo hawaahu afa'anta takoonu 'alayhi wakeelaa
ayahs.translationClear: Have you seen him who chose his desire as his god? Would you be an agent for him?

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ ۚ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ ۖ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ‌ۚ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ‌ۖ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا ۝٤٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ تَحْسَبُ اَنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُوْنَ اَوْ يَعْقِلُوْنَؕ اِنْ هُمْ اِلَّا كَالْاَنْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ اَضَلُّ سَبِيْلًا ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock.[1027] Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.
ayahs.transliteration: Am tahsabu anna aktharahum yasma'oona aw ya'qiloona in hum illaa kal-an'aami bal hum adallu sabeelaa

footnotes.1027: i.e., cattle or sheep, that follow without question wherever they are led.

ayahs.translationClear: Or do you assume that most of them hear or understand? They are just like cattle, but even more errant in their way.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِنًا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا ٱلشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِنًا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا ٱلشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًا ۝٤٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلَمْ تَرَ اِلٰي رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ الظِّلَّۚ وَلَوْ شَا࢜ءَ لَجَعَلَهٗ سَاكِنًاۚ ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا الشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيْلًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.[1028]
ayahs.transliteration: Alam tara ilaa rabbika kayfa maddaz-zilla walaw shaa'a laja'alahoo saakinan thumma ja'alnash-shamsa 'alayhi daleelaa

footnotes.1028: i.e., showing the existence of a shadow or making it apparent by contrast.

ayahs.translationClear: Do you not see how your Lord extends the shadow? Had He willed, He could have made it still. And We made the sun a pointer to it.

ayahs.textUthmani: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًا يَسِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًا يَسِيرًا ۝٤٦
ayahs.textIndopak: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنٰهُ اِلَيْنَا قَبْضًا يَّسِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: Then We [retract and] hold it with Us for a brief grasp.[1029]
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma qabadnaahu ilaynaa qabdan yaseeraa

footnotes.1029: i.e., when the sun is overhead at noon.

ayahs.translationClear: Then We withdraw it towards Us gradually.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا وَٱلنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا وَٱلنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورًا ۝٤٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا وَّالنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًا وَّجَعَلَ النَّهَارَ نُشُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing[1030] and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.[1031]
ayahs.transliteration: Wahuwal-ladhee ja'ala lakumul-layla libaasan wan-nawma subaatan waja'alan-nahaara nushooraa

footnotes.1030: Covering you in darkness and providing rest.
footnotes.1031: For renewal of life and activity.

ayahs.translationClear: And it is He who made the night a covering for you, and sleep for rest; and He made the day a revival.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً طَهُورًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦ‌ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً طَهُورًا ۝٤٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَهُوَ الَّذِيْٓ اَرْسَلَ الرِّيٰحَ بُشْرًاۢ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهٖۚ وَاَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ مَا࢜ءً طَهُوْرًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy [i.e., rainfall], and We send down from the sky pure water
ayahs.transliteration: Wahuwal-ladhee arsalar-riyaaha bushram bayna yaday rahmatihee wa'anzalnaa minas-samaa'i maa'an tahooraa
ayahs.translationClear: And it is He who sends the winds, bringing advance news of His mercy; and We send down from the sky pure water.

ayahs.textUthmani: لِّنُحْـِۧىَ بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا وَنُسْقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا وَأَنَاسِىَّ كَثِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِّنُحْـِۧىَ بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا وَنُسْقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا وَأَنَاسِىَّ كَثِيرًا ۝٤٩
ayahs.textIndopak: لِّنُحْيِۦَ بِهٖ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا وَّنُسْقِيَهٗ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَا͏ٓ اَنْعَامًا وَّاَنَاسِيَّ كَثِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men.
ayahs.transliteration: Linuheeya bihee baldatam maytan wanusqiyahoo mimmaa khalaqnaa an'aaman wa'anaasiyya katheeraa
ayahs.translationClear: To revive dead lands thereby, and to provide drink for the multitude of animals and humans We created.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَـٰهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَـٰهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا ۝٥٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنٰهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوْاؗۖ فَاَبٰٓي اَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ اِلَّا كُفُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded,[1032] but most of the people refuse except disbelief.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad sarrafnaahu baynahum liyadhdhakkaroo fa'abaa aktharun-naasi illaa kufooraa

footnotes.1032: Of Allāh's ability to bring the dead to life.

ayahs.translationClear: We have circulated it among them, that they may reflect, but most people persist in thanklessness.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ نَّذِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ نَّذِيرًا ۝٥١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَوْ شِي͏ٔ͏ْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِيْ كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ نَّذِيْرًا ؗۖ
ayahs.translation: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.[1033]
ayahs.transliteration: Walaw shi'naa laba'athnaa fee kulli qaryatin nadheeraa

footnotes.1033: However, Allāh willed that Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) be sent as the final messenger for all peoples of the earth until the Day of Resurrection.

ayahs.translationClear: Had We willed, We could have sent to every town a warner.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَجَـٰهِدْهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادًا كَبِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَجَـٰهِدْهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادًا كَبِيرًا ۝٥٢
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَا تُطِعِ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ وَجَاهِدْهُمْ بِهٖ جِهَادًا كَبِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with it [i.e., the Qur’ān] a great striving.
ayahs.transliteration: Falaa tuti'il-kaafireena wajaahid'hum bihee jihaadan kabeeraa
ayahs.translationClear: So do not obey the disbelievers, but strive against them with it, a mighty struggle.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ هَـٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَهَـٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَحِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ هَـٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَهَـٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَحِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا ۝٥٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ هٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَّهٰذَا مِلْحٌ اُجَاجٌۚ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَّحِجْرًا مَّحْجُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas [i.e., bodies of water], one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.
ayahs.transliteration: Wahuwal-ladhee marajal-bahrayni haadhaa 'adhbun furaatun wahaadhaa milhun ujaajun waja'ala baynahumaa barzakhan wahijram mahjooraa
ayahs.translationClear: And it is He who merged the two seas; this one fresh and sweet, and that one salty and bitter; and He placed between them a barrier, and an impassable boundary.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبًا وَصِهْرًا ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبًا وَصِهْرًا‌ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًا ۝٥٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ مِنَ الْمَا࢜ءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهٗ نَسَبًا وَّصِهْرًاؕ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: And it is He who has created from water [i.e., semen] a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].
ayahs.transliteration: Wahuwal-ladhee khalaqa minal-maa'i basharan faja'alahoo nasaban wasihran wakaana rabbuka qadeeraa
ayahs.translationClear: And it is He who, from fluid, created the human being. Then He made relationships through marriage and mating. Your Lord is Omnipotent.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ‌ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرًا ۝٥٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا يَنْفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْؕ وَكَانَ الْكَافِرُ عَلٰي رَبِّهٖ ظَهِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: But they worship rather than Allāh that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].
ayahs.transliteration: Waya'budoona min doonillaahi maa laa yanfa'uhum walaa yadurruhum wakaanal-kaafiru 'alaa rabbihee zaheeraa
ayahs.translationClear: And yet, instead of Allah, they serve what neither profits them nor harms them. The disbeliever has always turned his back on his Lord.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا ۝٥٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَرْسَلْنٰكَ اِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَّنَذِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa arsalnaaka illaa mubashshiran wanadheeraa
ayahs.translationClear: We sent you only as a herald of good news and a warner.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا ۝٥٧
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ مَا͏ٓ اَسْـٔ͏َلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ اِلَّا مَنْ شَا࢜ءَ اَنْ يَّتَّخِذَ اِلٰي رَبِّهٖ سَبِيْلًا
ayahs.translation: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul maa as'alukum 'alayhi min ajrin illaa man shaa'a an yattakhidha ilaa rabbihee sabeelaa
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “I ask of you no payment for this—only that whoever wills may take a path to his Lord.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْحَىِّ ٱلَّذِى لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْحَىِّ ٱلَّذِى لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِۦ‌ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا ۝٥٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَي الْحَيِّ الَّذِيْ لَا يَمُوْتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهٖؕ وَكَفٰي بِهٖ بِذُنُوْبِ عِبَادِهٖ خَبِيْرَا ۙۚۛ
ayahs.translation: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allāh] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, [fully] Aware -
ayahs.transliteration: Watawakkal 'alal-hayyil-ladhee laa yamootu wasabbih bihamdihee wakafaa bihee bidhunoobi 'ibaadihee khabeeraa
ayahs.translationClear: And put your trust in the Living, the One who never dies; and celebrate His praise. He suffices as the All-Informed Knower of the faults of His creatures.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَسْـَٔلْ بِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ‌ۚ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَسْـَٔلْ بِهِۦ خَبِيرًا ۝٥٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اࣙلَّذِيْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِيْ سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوٰي عَلَي الْعَرْشِۚۛ اَلرَّحْمٰنُ فَسْـٔ͏َلْ بِهٖ خَبِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne[1034] - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)].
ayahs.transliteration: Al-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa fee sittati ayyaamin thummastawaa 'alal-'arshir-rahmaanu fas'al bihee khabeeraa
ayahs.translationClear: He who created the heavens and the earth and everything between them in six days, then settled on the Throne. The Most Merciful. Ask about Him a well-informed.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ قَالُوا۟ وَمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًا ۩
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ قَالُوا۟ وَمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًا ۩ ۝٦٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِذَا قِيْلَ لَهُمُ اسْجُدُوْا لِلرَّحْمٰنِ قَالُوْا وَمَا الرَّحْمٰنُࣗ اَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَاْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُوْرًا ࣛࣖ
ayahs.translation: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'idhaa qeela lahumusjudoo lirrahmaani qaaloo wamar-rahmaanu anasjudu limaa ta'murunaa wazaadahum nufooraa
ayahs.translationClear: And when it is said to them, “Bow down to the Merciful,” they say, “And what is the Merciful? Are we to bow down to whatever you command us?” And it increases their aversion.

ayahs.textUthmani: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجًا وَقَمَرًا مُّنِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجًا وَقَمَرًا مُّنِيرًا ۝٦١
ayahs.textIndopak: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِيْ جَعَلَ فِي السَّمَا࢜ءِ بُرُوْجًا وَّجَعَلَ فِيْهَا سِرٰجًا وَّقَمَرًا مُّنِيْرًا
ayahs.translation: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.
ayahs.transliteration: Tabaarakal-ladhee ja'ala fis-samaa'i buroojan waja'ala feehaa siraajan waqamaram muneeraa
ayahs.translationClear: Blessed is He who placed constellations in the sky, and placed in it a lamp, and an illuminating moon.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِّمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِّمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًا ۝٦٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ جَعَلَ الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِّمَنْ اَرَادَ اَنْ يَّذَّكَّرَ اَوْ اَرَادَ شُكُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.
ayahs.transliteration: Wahuwal-ladhee ja'alal-layla wan-nahaara khilfatal liman araada an yadhdhakkara aw araada shukooraa
ayahs.translationClear: And it is He who made the night and the day alternate—for whoever desires to reflect, or desires to show gratitude.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلْجَـٰهِلُونَ قَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلْجَـٰهِلُونَ قَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۝٦٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمٰنِ الَّذِيْنَ يَمْشُوْنَ عَلَي الْاَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَّاِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ الْجٰهِلُوْنَ قَالُوْا سَلٰمًا
ayahs.translation: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily,[1035] and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,[1036]
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'ibaadur-rahmaanil-ladheena yamshoona 'alal-ardi hawnan wa'idhaa khaatabahumul-jaahiloona qaaloo salaamaa

footnotes.1035: i.e., gently, with dignity but without arrogance.
footnotes.1036: Or "safety," i.e., words free from fault or evil.

ayahs.translationClear: The servants of the Merciful are those who walk the earth in humility, and when the ignorant address them, they say, “Peace.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَقِيَـٰمًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَقِيَـٰمًا ۝٦٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ يَبِيْتُوْنَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَّقِيَامًا
ayahs.translation: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-ladheena yabeetoona lirabbihim sujjadan waqiyaamaa
ayahs.translationClear: And those who pass the night prostrating themselves to their Lord and standing up.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ‌ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا ۝٦٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ يَقُوْلُوْنَ رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَࣗۖ اِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا ࣗۖ
ayahs.translation: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-ladheena yaqooloona rabbanasrif 'annaa 'adhaaba jahannama inna 'adhaabahaa kaana gharaamaa
ayahs.translationClear: And those who say, “Our Lord, avert from us the suffering of Hell, for its suffering is continuous.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا ۝٦٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّهَا سَا࢜ءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَّمُقَامًا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."
ayahs.transliteration: Innahaa saa'at mustaqarran wamuqaamaa
ayahs.translationClear: It is indeed a miserable residence and destination.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا۟ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا۟ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًا ۝٦٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ اِذَا͏ٓ اَنْفَقُوْا لَمْ يُسْرِفُوْا وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوْا وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذٰلِكَ قَوَامًا
ayahs.translation: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-ladheena idhaa anfaqoo lam yusrifoo walam yaqturoo wakaana bayna dhaalika qawaamaa
ayahs.translationClear: And those who, when they spend, are neither wasteful nor stingy, but choose a middle course between that.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ‌ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًا ۝٦٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ لَا يَدْعُوْنَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُوْنَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِيْ حَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُوْنَۚ وَمَنْ يَّفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ يَلْقَ اَثَامًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: And those who do not invoke[1037] with Allāh another deity or kill the soul which Allāh has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-ladheena laa yad'oona ma'allaahi ilaahan aakhara walaa yaqtuloonan-nafsal-latee harramallaahu illaa bil-haqqi walaa yaznoona waman yaf'al dhaalika yalqa athaamaa
ayahs.translationClear: And those who do not implore besides Allah any other god, and do not kill the soul which Allah has made sacred—except in the pursuit of justice—and do not commit adultery. Whoever does that will face penalties.

ayahs.textUthmani: يُضَـٰعَفْ لَهُ ٱلْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يُضَـٰعَفْ لَهُ ٱلْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا ۝٦٩
ayahs.textIndopak: يُّضٰعَفْ لَهُ الْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيْهٖ مُهَانًا ࣗۖ
ayahs.translation: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -
ayahs.transliteration: Yudaa'af lahul-'adhaabu yawmal-qiyaamati wayakhlud feehee muhaanaa
ayahs.translationClear: The punishment will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will dwell therein in humiliation forever.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَـٰتٍ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَـٰتٍ‌ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا ۝٧٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلَّا مَنْ تَابَ وَاٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَاُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللّٰهُ سَيِّاٰتِهِمْ حَسَنٰتٍؕ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِيْمًا
ayahs.translation: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allāh will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: Illaa man taaba wa'aamana wa'amila 'amalan saalihan fa'ulaa'ika yubaddilullaahu sayyi'aatihim hasanaatin wakaanallaahu ghafoorar raheemaa
ayahs.translationClear: Except for those who repent, and believe, and do good deeds. These—Allah will replace their bad deeds with good deeds. Allah is ever Forgiving and Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابًا ۝٧١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَنْ تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَاِنَّهٗ يَتُوْبُ اِلَي اللّٰهِ مَتَابًا
ayahs.translation: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allāh with [accepted] repentance.
ayahs.transliteration: Waman taaba wa'amila saalihan fa'innahoo yatoobu ilallaahi mataabaa
ayahs.translationClear: Whoever repents and acts righteously—has inclined towards Allah with repentance.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِٱللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا۟ كِرَامًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِٱللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا۟ كِرَامًا ۝٧٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ لَا يَشْهَدُوْنَ الزُّوْرَۙ وَاِذَا مَرُّوْا بِاللَّغْوِ مَرُّوْا كِرَامًا
ayahs.translation: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-ladheena laa yashhadoonaz-zoora wa'idhaa marroo bil-laghwi marroo kiraamaa
ayahs.translationClear: And those who do not bear false witness; and when they come across indecencies, they pass by with dignity.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا۟ عَلَيْهَا صُمًّا وَعُمْيَانًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا۟ عَلَيْهَا صُمًّا وَعُمْيَانًا ۝٧٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ اِذَا ذُكِّرُوْا بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوْا عَلَيْهَا صُمًّا وَّعُمْيَانًا
ayahs.translation: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-ladheena idhaa dhukkiroo bi'aayaati rabbihim lam yakhirroo 'alayhaa summan wa'umyaanaa
ayahs.translationClear: And those who, when reminded of the revelations of their Lord, do not fall before them deaf and blind.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا ۝٧٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ يَقُوْلُوْنَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ اَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ اَعْيُنٍ وَّاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَ اِمَامًا
ayahs.translation: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes[1038] and make us a leader [i.e., example] for the righteous."
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-ladheena yaqooloona rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wadhurriyyaatinaa qurrata a'yunin waj'alnaa lilmuttaqeena imaamaa

footnotes.1038: i.e., a source of happiness due to their righteousness.

ayahs.translationClear: And those who say, “Our Lord, grant us delight in our spouses and our children, and make us a good example for the righteous.”

ayahs.textUthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ ٱلْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَـٰمًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ ٱلْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَـٰمًا ۝٧٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ يُجْزَوْنَ الْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوْا وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيْهَا تَحِيَّةً وَّسَلٰمًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: Those will be awarded the Chamber[1039] for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace,
ayahs.transliteration: Ulaa'ika yujzawnal-ghurfata bimaa sabaroo wayulaqqawna feehaa tahiyyatan wasalaamaa

footnotes.1039: The most elevated portion of Paradise.

ayahs.translationClear: Those will be awarded the Chamber for their patience, and will be greeted therein with greetings and peace.

ayahs.textUthmani: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا‌ۚ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا ۝٧٦
ayahs.textIndopak: خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَاؕ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَّمُقَامًا
ayahs.translation: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.
ayahs.transliteration: Khaalideena feehaa hasunat mustaqarran wamuqaamaa
ayahs.translationClear: Abiding therein forever—it is an excellent residence and destination.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا۟ بِكُمْ رَبِّى لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًۢا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا۟ بِكُمْ رَبِّى لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ‌ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًۢا ۝٧٧
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَو͏ٔ͏ُا بِكُمْ رَبِّيْ لَوْلَا دُعَا࢜و͏ٔ͏ُكُمْۚ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُوْنُ لِزَامًا ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?"[1040] For you [disbelievers] have denied, so it [i.e., your denial] is going to be adherent.[1041]
ayahs.transliteration: Qul maa ya'ba'u bikum rabbee lawlaa du'aa'ukum faqad kadhdhabtum fasawfa yakoonu lizaamaa

footnotes.1040: i.e., faith and worship. An alternative meaning is "What would my Lord do with you..."
footnotes.1041: It will remain with them, causing punishment to be required and imperative upon them.

ayahs.translationClear: Say, “What are you to my Lord without your prayers? You have denied the truth, and the inevitable will happen.”
